card.name: Article after a drug name appositive
card.fires_on: Small linking words (a, an, of, with, potent) right after a named interacting drug such as rifampin or verapamil, just before a description like 'a strong CYP3A4 inducer' or 'an inhibitor of'.

modes.label: Appositive article
modes.description: The article 'a' or 'an' after a comma following a drug name, introducing its enzyme or transporter role.
modes.example: Coadministration of RUKOBIA with rifampin,<< a>> strong CYP3A4 inducer

modes.label: Other linking words in interaction text
modes.description: Words like 'potent', 'of' or 'with' in descriptions of an inducer or inhibitor, or in interaction headings.
modes.example: Cobicistat, a component of STRIBILD, is an inhibitor<< of>> CYP3A and CYP2

card.plain: It fires on the small word that comes right after an interacting drug's name and begins describing its enzyme role.
